name: Ad Abolendam against heretics
summary: Lucius III's decretal Ad Abolendam, issued jointly with Frederick Barbarossa at Verona, names Cathars, Patarines, Waldensians, and other heretical movements and obliges secular princes to assist bishops in their suppression.

_quarry.structural_significance: First systematic episcopal-inquisitorial procedure against heresy; establishes the legal framework that Gregory IX formalises into the papal inquisition in 1231.
